record.title: Healthcare Regulatory Compliance Advisor
record.about_headline: Healthcare licensing and clinical governance advisor for private hospitals, clinic groups and eldercare operators in Singapore.
record.about_bio: I have spent 16 years in Singapore healthcare regulation and quality. I began as a staff nurse, moved into a Singapore-based public hospital group's accreditation office, then led the licensing and clinical governance function of a Singapore-based private hospital operator, and later headed compliance for an eldercare chain with nine homes. I hold a nursing degree and a Master of Health Administration, and now practise as an independent healthcare compliance advisor to smaller providers.

services.service_title: Licensing Readiness and Compliance Gap Review
services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore clinic groups, medical centres and eldercare operators. Services include a review of alignment with MOH licensing conditions under the Healthcare Services Act, policy and incident-process checks, complaint handling review, a prioritised corrective plan for the board, and a management briefing. One operator per engagement.

achievements: Advised a private hospital through a full licence renewal in 14 weeks.
Steered a 12-clinic dental group through its first licence variation cycle.
Recommended fixes that cut repeat incidents by 40% at an eldercare chain.
Diagnosed consent-process gaps for a telehealth provider in a 3-week review.
record.how_i_work: I start with the licence conditions and guidance that bind the operator, walk through daily practice with frontline staff, then give the board a short written view of where proportionality allows a lighter touch and what must change first.
